2757-4573-6753.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

4365-4871-6705.description:
Activate Quina by paying {2} and sacrificing a Frog.
When the Frog dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens due to Quina and Mondrak.
Resolve the Quina ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

3986-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3986-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4131-4893-7329.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2438-5237.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2281-2438-5237.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3140-5465-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

1308-3484-5391-6774.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1308-3484-5391-6774.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2324-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4231-4321-5270-5682-6797.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Astrid
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

394-856-4779-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2577-5147-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1817-4659-5365.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{G/U}{G/U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1817-4659-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
1817-4659-5365.description:
Cast Lonis either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Lonis spell.
Resolve both Lonis spells.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat from step 4.
1817-4659-5365.notes:
You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

222-527-955-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

413-586-5626-6112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

717-4798-5436-5686.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-4871-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Woe Strider four times by sacrificing four Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities, causing you to scry 1 four times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

2011-2060-5501.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
Ornery Tumblewagg does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2011-2060-5501.description:
Activate Ornery Tumblewagg's saddle ability by tapping Crystalline Crawler, causing Ornery Tumblewagg to become saddled until end of turn.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ornery Tumblewagg's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Declare Ornery Tumblewagg and Najeela, if desired, as an attacker.
Ornery Tumblewagg's second ability triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
If Najeela was declared as an attacker, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
If Crystalline Crawler begins the combo with four or more +1/+1 counters, this combo will net infinite +1/+1 counters on it and colored mana, which will allow you to target any other creature(s) using Ornery Tumblewagg's triggers.

2107-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Sunastian Falconer.
Sunastian Falconer does not have summoning sickness.
2107-3263-3525.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Sunastian Falconer.
Repeat.

2393-2399-3693.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Colfenor and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Spawn dies, triggering Colfenor, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of {C}, you may cast Walking Ballista using an arbitrarily large amount of mana, then use its ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
